analysis.title: The $625 billion question
key_insights: Nvidia earned about $5bn annually when ChatGPT launched in 2022. Earnings are now approaching $240bn, per DB's Jim Reid.
Consensus expects $625bn of NVDA earnings in 2031. That estimate has more than doubled in one year.
NVDA is down 35% from its October peak despite the upward revision to long-term earnings estimates.
NVDA trades at roughly 6x projected 2031 earnings, per DB's Jim Reid.
At a 16x multiple on $625bn of 2031 earnings, NVDA's market cap would be about $10 trillion.
Technically, NVDA is testing a trendline dating to 2023 and sits below its 100-week moving average. The 200-week moving average is still comfortably lower.
Investors are questioning hyperscaler spending, competition from custom chips and the sustainability of Nvidia's margins ahead of earnings.
Retail investors have been buying NVDA puts, so bearish positioning is building into earnings.
earnings_insights: NVDA earnings approaching (date not stated in the report). Consensus 2031 earnings estimate is $625bn, a forecast that has more than doubled in a year.
NVDA annual earnings were about $5bn in 2022 and are 'approaching $240bn' today, per DB's Jim Reid. The report does not say whether this is reported or adjusted, or which period it covers.
risk_factors: Consensus 2031 earnings forecasts may be too optimistic.
Technical breakdown: NVDA is testing its 2023 trendline and trades below the 100-week moving average.
charts_described: NVDA price chart: the stock is testing a trendline dating back to 2023 and remains below its 100-week moving average, with the 200-week moving average still comfortably lower.
vol_and_positioning: Retail investors have been loading up on NVDA puts (CBOE data cited as the chart source).
Bearish positioning is building into Nvidia earnings, alongside a fragile technical picture and an intensifying fundamental debate.

tension_points.bull_case: Consensus 2031 earnings of $625bn, more than double the estimate a year ago. NVDA trades at about 6x that figure, and a 16x multiple would imply a $10 trillion market cap (DB's Jim Reid).
tension_points.bear_case: The forecasts may be too optimistic. Investors question hyperscaler spending, custom chip competition and margin sustainability. The stock is 35% off its October peak, testing a 2023 trendline and below its 100-week moving average, and retail is buying puts.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A break of the 2023 trendline that NVDA is currently testing.

theme_stances.key_argument: Either the market is underestimating Nvidia's future earnings power or the forecasts are too optimistic.
theme_stances.evidence: Either the market is dramatically underestimating Nvidia's future earnings power
